title: Scoped learning surfaces preserve one durable approval authority
summary: Bind reusable learning to the exact reviewed candidate and scope across curation, approval, publication, and recovery.
reusable_steps: Bind reusable learning to the exact reviewed candidate and scope across curation, approval, publication, and recovery
expected_outcome: Use one canonical approval store and freeze exact candidate content, scope, and publication destination. Enforce server-resolved scope before every card, detail, count, decision and challenge. Treat lost mutation responses as unknown and reconcile canonical consumption plus artifact identity before retrying. Reject forged receipt/reference paths before content IO. Test partial artifact creation and the crash between durable consumption and queue finalization. Preserve terminal legacy deep links and scope-bound UI keys. Passing local checks does not establish browser accessibility or measured learning quality.
